Asha (CS): quick harvest from 12 onboarding calls — consolidated asks that touch billing, onboarding UX, and renewal signals.
Liam (CS): drop the short list pls, i'll flag renewals.
Asha (CS): CSV snippet:
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
harbor,chargeback-labels,feature,high,needs cost-center labels on requests for internal chargebacks
pioneer,recon-api,feature,high,finance wants an API to fetch usage ledgers by label
rivet,bulk-invite,feature,medium,bulk invite + role presets to speed team setup
```
Liam (CS): harbor + pioneer both mentioned renewals if finance can't reconcile.
Raj (PM): chargeback-labels vs recon-api — can one feature satisfy both? what's minimal MVP?
Clara (Eng): MVP: accept header 'X-Cost-Labels' persisted with usage events + include labels in exports. recon-api = endpoint that returns aggregated rows by label/time-window. effort: labels ingestion + export ~5 dev days, recon-api ~4 dev days. UI for label management later.
Liam (CS): sounds good. low-friction win: accept labels + CSV export as CS pilot to Harbour and Pioneer.
Asha (CS): will draft outreach. add these quotes to ticket: "We can't allocate costs without labels" and "Finance needs an API to pull ledgers weekly".
ticket-bot: created jira CS-7011 "chargeback labels + recon API (CS pilot)" assigned to @clara.
Raj (PM): prioritize labels + CSV export this sprint; recon-api as follow-up sprint. Please add ACs to ticket.
Clara (Eng): ACs i'll add after spike. Rough ACs: 1) ingest header+validate labels, 2) persist to usage events, 3) export CSV with label columns, 4) auth/org scoping. Spike tomorrow.
Asha (CS): thanks — i'll notify Harbour & Pioneer with ETA and offer staging access. :handshake:
